top.title: Lady A - Bigger Picture | Clipping
top.description: This is a quiet, faith led song and the campaign should feel the same way. You are not chasing shock value here. You are putting a song in front of people who need to hear it, and getting them to send it to someone else.
top.brief: Sometimes a song finds you at exactly the moment you need it most. ❤️ Lady A’s emotional new single “Bigger Picture” is a beautiful reminder that even when life feels overwhelming, there’s still hope in the things we cannot see or understand yet. The Grammy-winning country trio, made up of Hillary Scott, Charles Kelley, and Dave Haywood, discovered the song just one day before returning to the studio to finish their next album. Something about its message resonated so deeply that they recorded it the following day. Built around heartfelt vocals, warm acoustic melodies, and a message of faith, “Bigger Picture” speaks to anyone navigating uncertainty, feeling lost, or simply trying to make sense of a difficult chapter in life. It’s about accepting that we’re only human, that doubt is natural, and that sometimes we have to trust there’s a greater purpose beyond what we can see right now. If someone you love is going through a difficult time, send them this song. Sometimes a small reminder of hope can mean more than words ever could.
